delete-description: The replay is removed for good. Anyone with its link will no longer be able to watch it.
description: Public replays appear on their game’s page. An unlisted replay opens only for you.
empty-description: Finish a run in a game that records replays and choose Save replay.
error-description: Check your connection and try again.
lock-ghost: A race ghost is always unlisted.
lock-speedrun: This replay is the proof for a speedrun entry, so it cannot be deleted or unlisted.
page-description: The runs you saved: make one public or unlisted, or delete it.
signed-out: Sign in to manage your replays.
title: Your replays
